cases.question: Can I return my laptop after 21 days?
expected_facts: the return window is 30 days from delivery
the laptop must meet the return eligibility conditions

cases.question: My package has had no tracking updates for 8 business days. What should I do?
expected_facts: contact customer support for an investigation when there are no tracking updates for 7 or more business days

cases.question: My package is lost 14 business days after the estimated delivery date. Can I get a refund?
expected_facts: a reshipment or full refund may be requested after 14 business days from the estimated delivery date

cases.question: I tried resetting my password twice, but I still cannot log in. What should I do?
expected_facts: escalate to support when password reset still fails after two attempts

cases.question: Does the company offer a 50% discount on all laptops?
expected_facts: the provided policy documents do not establish whether this discount exists
do not invent a discount policy
